source.body:
# MCPエコシステム動向ダイジェスト

生成日: 2026-10-19

## 新着MCPサーバーリポジトリ（GitHub topic検索）

- [plugolis/plugolis-mcp](https://github.com/plugolis/plugolis-mcp) （★0）— MCP server for Plugolis: search MCP servers and fixes for MCP errors from your AI assistant
- [jack-reson8/toolkb-mcp](https://github.com/jack-reson8/toolkb-mcp) （★0）— Turn any link into AI-ready Markdown for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor: YouTube transcripts, web pages, App Store reviews. Local MCP, no API key.
- [patrickkellyyoung-ai/swarm-agora-mcp](https://github.com/patrickkellyyoung-ai/swarm-agora-mcp) （★0）— Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for WhisperAI Studio Swarm Agora. Autonomous agents query Kelly & Anna Swarm Council and earn credits by solving open engineering bounties.
- [KhyKd/eggtimer_app_docs](https://github.com/KhyKd/eggtimer_app_docs) （★0）— Docs for Eggtimer.app's two remote MCP servers: shareable timer links (no auth) and server-side timers/routines. Docs only, no server code.
- [tradertanmay/agent-opt](https://github.com/tradertanmay/agent-opt) （★1）— Optimize Claude Code, Codex, Cursor & Antigravity with smarter context, fewer tokens, faster coding and automatic verification.
- [paul0610/runpost](https://github.com/paul0610/runpost) （★0）— The HTTP client you and your AI agent share: a Postman-like desktop app (Rust + Tauri) with a built-in MCP server for Claude Code, Codex and other agents. One binary, no account, no telemetry.
- [racstan/progressor-mcp](https://github.com/racstan/progressor-mcp) （★0）— An MCP server that keeps an AI Agent and the Developer focused on their Goals across context compression and distractions.
- [popnow-ai/popnow-mcp](https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-mcp) （★0）— PopNow MCP server: AI image, video, music and speech generation for ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, VS Code and any MCP client. OAuth or API key.
- [amigoer/bucky](https://github.com/amigoer/bucky) （★0）— An open-source, AI-native desktop client for all your object storage: Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, Alibaba Cloud OSS, Tencent Cloud COS, Qiniu and any S3-compatible service, on macOS, Windows and Linux. / 开源、AI 原生的对象存储桌面客户端，在 macOS、Windows、Linux 上统一管理 R2、S3、OSS、COS、七牛等国内外对象存储。
- [aixwangtw/feedback-desk](https://github.com/aixwangtw/feedback-desk) （★2）— 跟客戶、團隊溝通系統調整的回報工具，部署在 Cloudflare Workers 免費方案；Claude Code、Codex 可透過 MCP／CLI 讀單、寫調整說明、改狀態 / Issue-reporting desk on Cloudflare Workers free plan with MCP and CLI for AI agents
- [kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp) （★105）— Local AI BGM and sound effects for Claude Code and any MCP client. Stable Audio 3 on Apple Silicon (MLX) and Windows NVIDIA GPUs (PyTorch). No cloud, no API key.
- [skullbloc/ck3agent](https://github.com/skullbloc/ck3agent) （★0）— Let Claude play Crusader Kings III: an MCP server over an in-process game bridge (research tool)
- [kanaworksai-hue/sonicproof](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/sonicproof) （★0）— Does your AI-generated sound match the prompt? Local QA for generative audio — check, rank, QC, picture-fit and library search with EmbeddingGemma 2. CLI, web workbench, MCP server.
- [AICodeForgedev/cadaddy](https://github.com/AICodeForgedev/cadaddy) （★1）— Free AutoCAD-style CAD for Windows, Mac and Linux that opens and saves DWG and DXF. Source-available (FSL-1.1). Written in Rust; MCP for AI agents.
- [hash066/stoop](https://github.com/hash066/stoop) （★0）— Sell anything without meeting anyone. An Alexa+ MCP add-on that haggles inside your limits and releases payment only when your Ring doorbell verifies the porch handoff.

## 公式org 新リリース（modelcontextprotocol）

- **modelcontextprotocol/inspector** 2.11.0 （2026-10-14T04:26:29Z）— [リリースノート](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/releases/tag/2.11.0)

## npm 新着パッケージ（keywords:mcp-server）

- [@next-ai-drawio/mcp-server](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@next-ai-drawio/mcp-server) — draw.io MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and VS Code: the AI draws on a live browser canvas you can also edit by hand, with versions and undo
- [@frontmcp/sdk](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@frontmcp/sdk) — TypeScript framework for building MCP servers: tools, resources and prompts as decorated classes, with transports, sessions, auth and dependency injection
- [@cargo-ai/cli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cargo-ai/cli) — Cargo, the go-to-market platform, from your terminal or coding agent: find and verify work emails, enrich companies and contacts, score leads and sync them to your CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce) across 130+ integrations, run plays and workflows, and serve it a
- [endfield-mcp](https://www.npmjs.com/package/endfield-mcp) — MCP Server for Arknights: Endfield (TypeScript / stdio + Streamable HTTP)
- [ffmpeg-skill](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ffmpeg-skill) — Agent Skill that gives coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) a local video editor: 42 FFmpeg tools with a machine-readable contract, contract-derived MCP server, FFmpeg capability detection, probe-first / verify-last workflow. Cut, join, silence remo
- [extraorbital](https://www.npmjs.com/package/extraorbital) — Provision cloud resources from the command line and write their credentials to .env
